fact: The Central Bank of Seychelles directed all banks, bureaux de change, credit unions, leasing companies and payment service providers to begin integrating SeyID, the national digital identity, into their customer due diligence processes (Directive No. 1 of 2025, issued 4 April 2025).
title: Directive on the Adoption and Acceptance of the National Digital Identity (SeyID) for Customer Due Diligence
